title: CPUNET subsys/bluetooth/host/hci_raw.c bt_enable_raw singleton adoption

instruction_shape_match.log_strings_source: The three strings are, verbatim and in this order, the only LOG_ERR/LOG_INF texts of NCS 2.5.1 zephyr/subsys/bluetooth/host/hci_raw.c bt_enable_raw() (lines 365-388).

runtime_defect_observed: hci_raw.c is a singleton: its `raw_rx` (0x210083d4 in the iteration-18 net link) is the fifo the STOCK bt_recv() puts controller->host buffers into, and only bt_enable_raw sets it.  The retained reconstruction set its own raw pin 0x210047fc instead, so the stock raw_rx stayed NULL and the stock bt_recv() could never deliver.  With bt_send()/bt_recv() already adopted from the same stock unit, the reconstruction was the only member of hci_raw.c that was NOT adopted.
consequence_measured: Iteration 19: the app core's bt_enable() reached bt_hci_cmd_send_sync(BT_HCI_OP_RESET=0x0c03) and bt_rpmsg_send() delivered it, but no HCI event ever came back and bt_hci_cmd_send_sync blocked; the CPUNET spun in FUN_0102acf4's `Unknown type %u` branch.
